morbi.headline: Morbi gets energy cost relief and Gulf exports resume amid weak overall outlook.
what_changed: Morbi's ceramic industry received a ₹5 discount on natural gas prices, bringing rates down from ₹82.
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed, though overall export demand remains weak.
Kajaria Ceramics reported a beat on sales and profit for Q2 2026.
stress_signals: Overall export outlook for the Morbi ceramic cluster remains weak despite the resumption of Gulf shipments [c2b4a2f5422a].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC, Morbi [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices for the Morbi ceramic industry were discounted by ₹5, dropping from ₹82 [279312659941].
Shipments to the Gulf have officially resumed for Morbi ceramic exporters [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Sustained shipment volumes and freight trends for Gulf export destinations.
Effective dates and full pricing structures of the ₹5 natural gas price discount.
Account-level capacity utilization and operational status of units in Rafaleshwar GIDC following coal seizures.

surat.headline: Mixed signals for Surat as demand and policy support contrast with severe liquidity and operational disruptions.
what_changed: Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold cut by 50% and extended to FY34, widening MSME eligibility.
US export demand slump and rough diamond shortages in nearby hubs weigh heavily on diamond and apparel exporters.
Textile units face operational stress from power cuts, tariff hikes, and potential fresh labor agitation.
stress_signals: Payment disputes between Surat weavers and traders escalated to police intervention [80f44f3f370f].
A textile mill owner was defrauded of Rs 1.69 crore through broker-assured fabric deliveries [25d6a0f6dbec].
Surat textile mills are impacted by power cuts and increased electricity tariffs [385f9b90ae46].
US demand slump triggered factory shutdowns across apparel and diamond exporting units [caa34a6cf84e].
improvement_signals: Textile market trade associations recovered Rs 6 crore in stuck payments for 70 local traders [a523a4bf860d].
Textile PLI Scheme minimum turnover eligibility reduced by 50% with tenure extended to FY 2033-34 [64c35d822d81].
ICA GemLab launched in Surat to offer international-grade diamond and jewelry testing [4b0e420193b2].
what_to_watch: Developments regarding potential fresh unrest across Surat textile units following August agitational trends [d1fffb80f879].
Monitor working capital strain and receivables turnover among local weavers due to ongoing trade payment disputes [80f44f3f370f].
Track capital allocation or diversion toward the IMT Sohna Textile Hub investor campaign [3d5fb8237567].
